title: Etale cohomology continuity for a uniformly bounded-below system of complexes
statement: Let $X=\varprojlim_{i\in I}X_i$ be a cofiltered inverse system of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with affine transition maps $f_{i'i}:X_{i'}\to X_i$, and let $f_i:X\to X_i$ be the projections. For each $i$, let $\mathcal F_i^\bullet$ be a complex of abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] on $X_i$, with morphisms of complexes $\varphi_{i'i}:f_{i'i}^{-1}\mathcal F_i^\bullet\to\mathcal F_{i'}^\bullet$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] for $i'\geq i$, unital (the self-transition $\varphi_{ii}$ is the canonical identity comparison $f_{ii}^{-1}\mathcal F_i^\bullet\cong\mathcal F_i^\bullet$) and compatible in the sense that $\varphi_{i''i}=\varphi_{i''i'}\circ f_{i''i'}^{-1}\varphi_{i'i}$ whenever $i''\geq i'\geq i$ (using the canonical identification $f_{i''i'}^{-1}f_{i'i}^{-1}\cong f_{i''i}^{-1}$ [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]). Suppose one integer $a$ satisfies $\mathcal F_i^n=0$ for every $i$ and every $n<a$. Set $\mathcal F^\bullet=\varinjlim_i f_i^{-1}\mathcal F_i^\bullet$, the colimit taken termwise. Then the canonical pullback maps induce, for every integer $p$, an isomorphism $\varinjlim_i H^p((X_i)_{\Et},\mathcal F_i^\bullet)\xrightarrow{\sim}H^p(X_{\Et},\mathcal F^\bullet)$, with complex cohomology defined by derived global sections [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology].

proof.text: Apply the class-descent half of the termwise spectral-sequence argument to obtain a stage representative of every element of the given cohomology cocone vertex.
For two elements at the same stage with equal images, subtract them and apply eventual vanishing to their difference. Additivity converts the zero transition image into equality at a later stage.

Apply Mathlib Types.FilteredColimit.isColimitOf' to the cocone after forgetting to types, using the representative and eventual-equality conditions. The forgetful functor from abelian groups preserves filtered colimits and reflects isomorphisms; reflectsColimit_of_reflectsIsomorphisms therefore lifts the resulting universal property back to abelian groups.

statement_change.what: The displayed cocycle law alone permits non-unital self-transitions: on a singleton indexing category, the zero endomorphism of a nonzero degree-zero constant abelian sheaf satisfies the cocycle law. Such data do not specify an ordinary categorical diagram because its identity arrow must act as the identity. Make explicit the unitality implicit in the source term system; no geometric hypothesis or cohomology conclusion changes.

citers.note: Its degree-zero system is unital by the meaning of a system of sheaves, and base change preserves the identity comparison.
Its transition maps are the canonical inverse-image composition isomorphisms, which are unital by inverse-image identity coherence.
